cases.name: empty
cases.note: No selection scores nothing and every race is insufficient.

cases.name: single-source
cases.note: One source: a lone endorsement cannot reach the explicit-source floor.

cases.name: two-sources-split
cases.note: Two sources expose split endorsements and exact tie resolution.

cases.name: category-labor
cases.note: Category selection follows current published membership.

cases.name: category-overlap-union
cases.note: Overlapping categories must not double-count a shared source.

cases.name: category-plus-member
cases.note: A source reached by both a category and a direct pick counts once.

cases.name: wrong-district
cases.note: District sources stay ineligible outside their own legislative races.

cases.name: comparison-refused
cases.note: The Seattle Times cannot contribute even when explicitly selected.

cases.name: excluded-refused
cases.note: An excluded source cannot be selected back into the panel.

cases.name: unknown-refused
cases.note: Unknown codes are ignored rather than scored.

cases.name: comparison-category-selected
cases.note: Selecting the comparison category can never enter the tally.

cases.name: full-panel
cases.note: Every selectable category reproduces the audited published consensus.
